description: This file declares the SimpleFileTracker class, which manages open file handles in a thread-safe manner for a disk cache system, including resource tracking, file registration, acquisition, closing, and doom management.

classes.name: SimpleFileTracker
classes.description: Manages open files for the disk cache, ensuring resource limits and thread safety.

classes.name: FileHandle
classes.description: RAII helper class for managing access to a file handle within SimpleFileTracker.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a file as backing a specific subfile for an owner.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Provides access to a file for an owner, ensuring it remains open while in use.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Indicates that an owner is no longer interested in a file, allowing it to be closed.

methods.name: Doom
methods.description: Marks an entry's doom generation to prevent conflicts.

methods.name: IsEmptyForTesting
methods.description: Checks if the tracker has no in-memory state (for testing).
